title: Circles of radii 1, 2, ..., N packed in the smallest circle or square

template.title: Circles of radii 1 to {n} in the container of Packomania section {section}
template.statement: Place {n} non-overlapping circles of radii 1, 2, ..., {n} in the container of section {section} whose size V (the radius of the circle, or the side of the square) is as small as possible.
template.submission: Text file: V on the first line, then {n} lines with the centres of the circles of radius 1, 2, ..., {n} in that order (decimal numbers), in the frame given by checkers/pack_check.py for section {section}.

score: the size V of the container (smaller is better)
best_text: The best known container in Packomania's table has size {best} ({holder}); a valid packing in a smaller one improves it.
open_rule: every N of the sections ccin and csqn whose value is not in bold (proven optimal), N >= 4
left_out: ccin: 0 proven, 3 small N; csqn: 0 proven, 3 small N; the sections with radii i^(1/2), i^(-1/2), i^(-2/3) and i^(-1/5) (irrational radii)
